description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecSkillBinTrust feature in the OpenClaw project. The tests verify the behavior of skill bin trust index building, skill auto approval based on trusted bins, and handling of executable paths. It uses Swift's XCTest framework, along with internal components like SkillBinsCache and ExecApprovalEvaluator, to ensure correct functionality of skill bin trust-related logic.

classes.name: ExecSkillBinTrustTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for ExecSkillBinTrust, verifying trust index resolution, auto allowance, and handling of executable paths.

methods.name: build trust index resolves skill bin paths
methods.description: Tests that the trust index correctly resolves skill bin paths.

methods.name: skill auto allow accepts trusted resolved skill bin path
methods.description: Tests that a trusted skill bin path is automatically allowed.

methods.name: skill auto allow rejects same basename at different path
methods.description: Ensures that skill auto-allow rejects executables with the same basename in different paths if not trusted.

methods.name: makeExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary executable file with specified name for testing purposes.

methods.name: makeReport
methods.description: Constructs a sample SkillsStatusReport with specified skill bin names for testing.
